title: Abnormal Returns following Business Model Extensions -The Role of Demand Relatedness
affiliations: WU Vienna University of Economics and Business and Vienna University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Abnormal Returns following Business Model Extensions -The Role of Demand Relatedness
detail.abstract: This article explores the impact of business model extensions (BMEs) on company performance by distinguishing between demand-related (BME-DR) and demand-unrelated (BME-DU) extensions. We explain that BME-DRs can enhance customer utility and, thus, drive firm performance. Furthermore, we hypothesize that a negative business outlook and the degree of diversification are important moderators of the BME-DR-performance relationship. We use an event study methodology to substantiate this claim and analyze abnormal returns following BME announcements. This approach allows us to precisely measure market reactions to announcements of BME-DR and BME-DU. Our findings reveal that BME-DRs lead to higher abnormal stock market returns than BME-DU. Moreover, companies with a pessimistic business outlook disproportionately benefit from BME-DRs. Finally, contrary to our hypothesis, we find that the benefits of BME-DRs do not uniformly accrue. Rather, the relationship between diversification and the effectiveness of such extensions follows an inverted U-shaped pattern, suggesting limited benefits for minimally and highly diversified firms. We discuss these findings and conclude that, beyond a certain level of overall company diversification, the cost of managing added complexity outweighs the benefits of BME-DRs.

AI.tldr: 该研究区分了需求相关和需求无关的业务模式扩展，发现需求相关的扩展能带来更高的股票异常回报，且业务前景悲观的公司从中获益更多。多元化程度与扩展效果呈倒U型关系。
AI.research_question: 需求相关与需求无关的业务模式扩展对公司绩效有何不同影响？业务前景和多元化程度如何调节这种关系？
AI.motivation: 业务模式扩展是公司增长的重要战略，但不同类型的扩展对绩效的影响机制尚不明确，需要区分需求相关和需求无关的扩展，并考察调节因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资源基础观和战略匹配理论，需求相关的扩展能增强客户效用；业务前景作为情境因素调节扩展效果；多元化程度影响组织复杂性管理能力。
AI.method: 采用事件研究法，分析业务模式扩展公告后的异常股票回报，精确测量市场对需求相关和需求无关扩展的反应。
AI.findings: 1. 需求相关的业务模式扩展比需求无关的扩展带来更高的异常股票回报；2. 业务前景悲观的公司从需求相关扩展中获益更多；3. 多元化程度与扩展效果呈倒U型关系，适度多元化的公司获益最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 区分了需求相关和需求无关的业务模式扩展；2. 识别了业务前景作为重要的调节变量；3. 揭示了多元化程度与扩展效果的倒U型关系，丰富了战略匹配理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 管理者应优先考虑需求相关的业务模式扩展；2. 业务前景悲观时，需求相关扩展是有效的战略选择；3. 公司需要平衡多元化程度，避免过度多元化带来的管理复杂性。

title: Retention strategies and predictors of retention for longitudinal observational cohort studies: A scoping review
affiliations: Seoul National University - College of Medicine, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Harvard University

detail.title: Retention strategies and predictors of retention for longitudinal observational cohort studies: A scoping review
detail.abstract: ObjectivesParticipant retention is key to generating meaningful findings in longitudinal research studies. Previous systematic reviews have identified strategies for increasing participant retention. This scoping review examines recent innovations in methodology used for participant retention and representation to inform retention practices in the All of Us Research Program (AoU).MethodsThree databases (PubMed, Embase, and CINAHL) were searched for recent studies to include in the literature review. Landmark longitudinal cohort studies were manually selected and searched on study websites and PubMed. AoU archive materials were identified on the AoU Confluence platform that stores internal study resources. Data on retention strategies were extracted, categorized according to retention themes identified in the systematic reviews by Robinson et al. (2015) and Teague et al. (2018), and summarized. Additional data on predictors of retention, digital retention methods, and new retention strategies were also extracted and narratively synthesized.ResultsTwenty-two longitudinal observational studies, 10 landmark cohort studies, and materials from 28 sites in the 14 AoU consortia met inclusion criteria. Contact and scheduling methods, visit characteristics, and special tracking methods were the most common retention themes used among the three data sources. Disability and lack of healthcare access were associated with lower odds of retention, whereas higher education and older age were associated with higher odds of retention. Digital strategies mostly involved the use of study websites, social media platforms, and digital tools to conduct follow-up, contact participants, or track participant information. The most common new strategies that were not included in previous reviews were retention committees, staff meetings on retention, and check-in calls. Segmentation approaches were identified as a new retention theme, including retention call lists and participant segmentation to individualize retention.ConclusionsThis scoping review reports on current methods used to retain participants in recent literature, landmark longitudinal cohort studies, and AoU archive materials. The review identified recent progress in the development and implementation of participant retention practices, as well as gaps in research assessing the effectiveness of specific retention strategies on increasing retention rates among different demographics, especially those who are underrepresented in biomedical research (UBR).

AI.tldr: 这篇范围综述系统梳理了纵向研究中参与者保留的最新方法，包括接触与安排、访问特征、特殊追踪等常见策略，并识别了数字工具、保留委员会、分段方法等创新实践，为"全民研究计划"提供参考。
AI.research_question: 纵向研究项目中，当前使用哪些创新的参与者保留和代表性方法？这些方法如何为"全民研究计划"的保留实践提供参考？
AI.motivation: 参与者保留对纵向研究产生有意义发现至关重要。虽然已有系统综述识别了保留策略，但需要了解最新方法创新，特别是为"全民研究计划"这一大型研究项目提供实践指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Robinson等人(2015)和Teague等人(2018)系统综述中识别的保留主题分类框架，包括接触与安排方法、访问特征、特殊追踪方法等保留主题。
AI.method: 范围综述方法：1)检索PubMed、Embase、CINAHL三个数据库；2)手动筛选标志性纵向队列研究；3)从"全民研究计划"Confluence平台获取内部资料。数据提取按保留主题分类，并进行叙事综合。
AI.findings: 1)接触与安排方法、访问特征、特殊追踪是最常用的保留主题；2)残疾和缺乏医疗保健与保留率较低相关，高等教育和年龄较大与保留率较高相关；3)数字策略主要涉及研究网站、社交媒体和数字工具；4)新策略包括保留委员会、保留员工会议和检查电话；5)分段方法成为新保留主题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1)扩展了参与者保留的理论框架，增加了分段方法作为新的保留主题；2)识别了数字时代保留策略的新维度；3)提供了保留预测因素的最新证据；4)为纵向研究方法论发展做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 1)为"全民研究计划"提供具体的保留实践参考；2)识别了针对不同人口统计学群体的有效保留策略；3)提供了数字工具在保留中的应用指南；4)强调了关注弱势群体保留的重要性；5)为研究团队建立保留机制提供操作建议。

title: Strengthening Public-Private Partnerships in Bangladesh: Institutional Challenges and Strategic Reforms for Vision 2041

detail.title: Strengthening Public-Private Partnerships in Bangladesh: Institutional Challenges and Strategic Reforms for Vision 2041

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, professional, or financial relationships that could be perceived as influencing this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on secondary data, document analysis, and publicly available sources. It did not involve human participants, interviews, surveys, or personal data, and therefore did not require formal ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Bangladesh's path to upper-middle-income status by 2041 hinges on transformative infrastructure expansion, with annual investment needs estimated at USD 10-12 billion. Conventional public financing mechanisms are insufficient to meet this demand, especially as external aid flows decline in the post-LDC transition. This paper positions Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) not as a supplementary tool, but as a strategic imperative for bridging fiscal gaps, mobilizing private capital, and accelerating infrastructure delivery across transport, energy, and urban services. Building on global PPP models and Bangladesh's policy evolution since 2010, the paper reviews frameworks from the UK, Australia, India, and China, and examines domestic challenges through reports and field-level experience. It incorporates practitioner insights from the author's roles in the Bangladesh Economic Zones Authority (BEZA), the Dhaka Bypass Expressway, and the Planning Commission. The paper uses a mixed-method approach combining document analysis, comparative case studies, and implementation experience to highlight the need for bankable project design, transparent procurement, and inclusive governance. It contributes to the policy discourse on development financing and institutional reform, offering strategic recommendations for policymakers, development partners, and civil society. It also shows how PPPs can advance key Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), including clean energy, decent work, innovation, and urban resilience.

AI.tldr: 孟加拉国要实现2041年成为中高收入国家的目标，每年需要100-120亿美元的基础设施投资。传统公共融资机制不足，尤其是在后LDC过渡期外部援助减少的情况下。该文主张将PPP（公私合作伙伴关系）作为战略要务，而非补充工具，以弥补财政缺口、动员私人资本并加速基础设施交付。
AI.research_question: 在孟加拉国面临传统公共融资不足和外部援助减少的背景下，如何通过PPP模式有效弥补基础设施投资缺口，加速实现2041年成为中高收入国家的目标？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国要实现2041年成为中高收入国家的目标，每年需要100-120亿美元的基础设施投资，但传统公共融资机制不足，特别是在后最不发达国家（LDC）过渡期外部援助减少的情况下，迫切需要寻找替代融资模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全球PPP模型理论框架，结合孟加拉国自2010年以来的政策演变，借鉴英国、澳大利亚、印度和中国的PPP框架，以及发展融资和制度变革理论。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：文献分析、比较案例研究（英国、澳大利亚、印度、中国）、基于作者在孟加拉国经济特区管理局、达卡绕城高速公路和计划委员会的实际实施经验分析。
AI.findings: PPP在孟加拉国不仅是补充工具，而是战略要务；需要可融资的项目设计、透明采购和包容性治理；PPP能推进清洁能源、体面工作、创新和城市韧性等可持续发展目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展融资和制度变革的政策讨论做出贡献，将PPP定位为战略要务而非补充工具的理论框架，提供基于实践经验的PPP实施理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、发展伙伴和民间社会提供战略建议，包括可融资项目设计、透明采购流程、包容性治理机制等具体实施方案，推动PPP在交通、能源和城市服务领域的应用。

title: Disputation on the Power and Efficiency of Representative Bureaucracy Debating Future Research Agendas
affiliations: American University

detail.title: Disputation on the Power and Efficiency of Representative Bureaucracy Debating Future Research Agendas
detail.abstract: In the tradition of Martin Luther posting 95 theses for debate on indulgences and related church issues, this papers offers 41 critical issues for debate in the literature on representative bureaucracy. 2 While they do not constitute a unified theory or theology of representative bureaucracy, they raise critical issues about the potential of representative bureaucracy to explain some key elements related to the role of bureaucracy in democratic governance and warn of pitfalls that will detract from key issues to less important theoretical/theological points.

AI.tldr: 该论文以马丁·路德张贴95条论纲的传统为类比，提出了41个关于代表性官僚制文献的批判性问题，旨在激发学术辩论而非构建统一理论。
AI.research_question: 代表性官僚制文献中存在哪些需要批判性辩论的关键问题？这些辩论如何帮助我们理解官僚机构在民主治理中的作用？
AI.motivation: 受到马丁·路德95条论纲的启发，作者认为代表性官僚制文献需要像宗教改革那样的批判性辩论，以澄清核心问题并避免陷入次要的理论争论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代表性官僚制理论，民主治理理论，官僚政治理论，以及马丁·路德宗教改革的类比框架。
AI.method: 批判性分析/辩论性方法，通过提出41个关键问题来系统审视代表性官僚制文献，类似于路德的论纲形式。
AI.findings: 识别出41个需要辩论的关键问题，这些问题涉及代表性官僚制解释民主治理中官僚作用的能力，以及该领域可能偏离核心问题的理论陷阱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供了系统性批判框架；2) 强调了代表性官僚制理论的局限性；3) 警告了理论发展可能偏离核心民主治理问题的风险；4) 建立了与宗教改革的历史类比以强调批判性辩论的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为学者提供了具体的辩论议题；2) 帮助政策制定者理解代表性官僚制的实际局限性；3) 促进更聚焦于民主治理核心问题的官僚制研究；4) 防止学术讨论陷入次要的理论争论。

title: From Tulip to Gold: Rational Bubbles in Consumable Assets
affiliations: Seoul National University - College of Business Administration and Amsterdam Business School, University of Amsterdam

detail.title: From Tulip to Gold: Rational Bubbles in Consumable Assets
detail.abstract: We study bubble dynamics when the speculative object is also a consumption good. We build an overlapping-generations model in which a storable asset can be held as a store of value or consumed for direct utility, making aggregate inventory (and effective float) central to pricing. The model yields two insights: (i) even small consumption value anchors resale prices to a consumption outside option, disciplining bubble indeterminacy and sharpening equilibrium selection; and (ii) fluctuations in "use" value trigger discrete, state-dependent reductions in circulating supply, producing sharp price moves around burn/bind/redeem events and tying bubbles to scarcity. We extend the framework to endogenous, costly issuance, generating feedback among prices, speculative demand, utility, and quantity. The model offers a unified lens for bubbles in storable commodities and in digital assets such as cryptocurrencies, tokens, and in-platform collectibles.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了当投机对象同时也是消费品时的泡沫动态。通过构建世代交叠模型，发现即使很小的消费价值也能将转售价格锚定在消费替代选项上，从而约束泡沫不确定性并锐化均衡选择。同时，"使用"价值的波动会引发流通供应的离散性、状态依赖性减少，产生围绕燃烧/绑定/赎回事件的剧烈价格变动，将泡沫与稀缺性联系起来。
AI.research_question: 当投机对象同时也是消费品时，泡沫动态如何变化？消费价值如何影响泡沫形成、稳定性和价格动态？
AI.motivation: 传统泡沫理论主要关注纯投机资产，但现实中许多投机对象（如大宗商品、加密货币、数字收藏品）也具有消费价值。需要理解消费价值如何改变泡沫动态，特别是对于可储存商品和数字资产。
AI.theoretical_framework: 世代交叠模型（OLG），资产既可作为价值储存手段，也可直接消费获得效用。关键概念包括：总库存、有效流通量、消费外部选择、泡沫不确定性、均衡选择、状态依赖性供应减少。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建包含可储存资产的世代交叠模型，资产可持有（投机）或消费（使用）。分析消费价值如何锚定价格、约束泡沫。扩展模型包含内生、有成本的发行，探讨价格、投机需求、效用和数量之间的反馈机制。
AI.findings: 1. 即使很小的消费价值也能将转售价格锚定在消费替代选项上，约束泡沫不确定性，锐化均衡选择。2. "使用"价值波动会引发流通供应的离散性、状态依赖性减少，产生围绕燃烧/绑定/赎回事件的剧烈价格变动，将泡沫与稀缺性联系起来。3. 内生发行模型显示价格、投机需求、效用和数量之间存在反馈机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为可储存商品和数字资产的泡沫提供了统一分析框架。2. 阐明了消费价值如何通过锚定效应约束泡沫不确定性。3. 揭示了稀缺性机制在泡沫形成中的核心作用。4. 扩展了传统泡沫理论，纳入消费价值维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解大宗商品、加密货币、代币和平台内收藏品的价格动态提供分析工具。2. 帮助政策制定者识别和管理具有消费价值的资产泡沫。3. 为投资者分析资产价格中的投机和消费价值成分提供框架。4. 对数字资产设计和监管有启示意义。

title: Productivity and Quality of Multi-product Firms
affiliations: University of Trento - School of International Studies, UNSW Business School and University of New South Wales - School of Economics

detail.title: Productivity and Quality of Multi-product Firms

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: International Finance Discussion Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a method for estimating productivity and quality at the firm-product level using a transformation function framework. We use firm optimization conditions to establish a one-to-one mapping between observed data and unobserved productivity and quality. We do not need to impute firm-product input shares and can avoid imposing productivity evolution processes. The method is scalable to numerous products and can address the bias caused by unobserved heterogeneous intermediate input prices. We apply the method to a set of Mexican manufacturing industries and examine the roles of across-firm and within-firm technological spillovers, accounting for the trade-off between productivity and quality. Our quantitative analysis shows that an exogenous, product-specific technological improvement generates substantial gains in welfare, amplified by both within-firm and across-firm spillovers by approximately 17 percent and 5 percent, respectively. Moreover, within-firm resource reallocation toward the most productive products accounts for 60 percent of the resulting firm-level productivity gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于转换函数框架的企业-产品层面生产率和质量估计方法，该方法利用企业优化条件建立观测数据与不可观测的生产率和质量之间的一对一映射，无需估算企业-产品投入份额，也无需假设生产率演化过程。该方法可扩展到多种产品，并能解决未观测到的异质性中间投入价格导致的偏差。应用于墨西哥制造业的实证分析显示，产品特定技术改进通过企业内和企业间技术溢出分别放大福利收益约17%和5%，且企业内资源向最有效产品的重新配置贡献了企业层面生产率增长的60%。
AI.research_question: 如何在企业-产品层面准确估计生产率和质量，并分析技术溢出效应和资源重新配置对企业绩效的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有生产率和质量估计方法通常需要估算企业-产品投入份额或假设生产率演化过程，且难以处理未观测到的异质性中间投入价格问题。此外，需要更好地理解企业内和企业间技术溢出效应以及资源重新配置对企业绩效的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 转换函数框架、企业优化理论、技术溢出理论、资源重新配置理论
AI.method: 基于转换函数框架的企业-产品层面估计方法，利用企业优化条件建立观测数据与不可观测变量的映射关系，无需估算投入份额或假设生产率演化过程。应用于墨西哥制造业数据的实证分析。
AI.findings: 1) 产品特定技术改进通过企业内和企业间技术溢出分别放大福利收益约17%和5%；2) 企业内资源向最有效产品的重新配置贡献了企业层面生产率增长的60%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了无需估算投入份额或假设生产率演化过程的企业-产品层面生产率和质量估计方法；2) 建立了处理未观测异质性中间投入价格偏差的框架；3) 整合了生产率和质量权衡的分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了评估技术改进福利效应的量化工具；2) 揭示了企业内资源重新配置对生产率增长的重要性；3) 为管理者优化产品组合和资源配置提供了实证依据。

title: Social Learning as a Microfoundation of Digital Entrepreneurial Ecosystems: Evidence from Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs)
affiliations: Technische Universität München (TUM) and Syracuse University - Whitman School of Management

detail.title: Social Learning as a Microfoundation of Digital Entrepreneurial Ecosystems: Evidence from Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs)
detail.abstract: We identify a core microfoundation of digital entrepreneurial ecosystems (EE): social learning in the form of information cascades. Using decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) as a laboratory where micro-level coordination processes are directly observable on blockchains, we trace how individual-level voting behavior aggregates into ecosystem-level outcomes. Exploring hand-collected data covering 19,450,710 votes from 924,095 unique voters in 3,317 DAO governance proposals, we estimate economically strong information cascades that run from influential through early to late voters. Several contextual factors impede social learning in DAOs, including the presence of cybercriminals in the DAO community and market sentiment, while the decentralization of token ownership is an important prerequisite for information cascades to unfold. Finally, we document a link between the potency of information cascades and the financial performance of DAOs. Stronger information cascades are associated with higher market capitalization, trading volume, and abnormal cryptocurrency token returns. Overall, we contribute to the EE literature by demonstrating how observable micro-level learning processes triggered by influential agents in the network scale into ecosystem-level financial performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用DAO作为实验室，发现信息级联是数字创业生态系统的核心微观基础。通过对1900多万次投票的分析，研究证实了从有影响力者到早期再到晚期投票者的信息级联效应，并发现网络犯罪、市场情绪等因素会阻碍社会学习，而代币所有权分散是信息级联的前提。信息级联强度与DAO财务绩效正相关。
AI.research_question: 数字创业生态系统（EE）的核心微观基础是什么？个体层面的投票行为如何聚合为生态系统层面的结果？信息级联在DAO治理中如何运作，以及哪些因素影响其效果？信息级联强度与DAO财务绩效有何关系？
AI.motivation: 理解数字创业生态系统的微观基础，特别是社会学习过程如何驱动生态系统层面的结果。DAO提供了独特的实验室环境，因为其区块链上的微观协调过程可直接观察，为研究个体行为如何聚合为集体结果提供了难得的机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字创业生态系统理论、社会学习理论、信息级联理论、网络效应理论、区块链治理理论
AI.method: 使用DAO作为自然实验环境，手工收集了3,317个DAO治理提案中的19,450,710次投票数据，涉及924,095个独特投票者。采用计量经济学方法估计信息级联效应，分析影响因素及其与财务绩效的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 存在显著的经济性信息级联效应，从有影响力者流向早期投票者再到晚期投票者；2. 网络犯罪分子的存在和市场情绪会阻碍DAO中的社会学习；3. 代币所有权分散是信息级联发生的重要前提；4. 信息级联强度与DAO财务绩效正相关，包括更高的市值、交易量和异常加密货币代币回报。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别信息级联作为数字创业生态系统的核心微观基础；2. 展示了微观层面的学习过程如何通过网络中有影响力的代理人扩展到生态系统层面的结果；3. 为创业生态系统理论提供了基于区块链环境的实证证据；4. 深化了对社会学习在数字治理中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为DAO设计者提供了优化治理结构的见解，特别是关于代币所有权分散的重要性；2. 帮助投资者评估DAO的治理质量和财务前景；3. 为监管机构理解区块链治理的动态提供了参考；4. 为创业生态系统参与者提供了社会学习机制的实际应用指导。

title: A Distributional Sensitivity Engine: Greeks from Two-Measure Digital Weights and Conditional Law Blocks

detail.title: A Distributional Sensitivity Engine: Greeks from Two-Measure Digital Weights and Conditional Law Blocks
detail.abstract: BSM Sensitivity Engine (BSE) derives a compact, implementation-oriented representation for first-and mixed second-order sensitivities of the Black-Scholes-Merton (BSM) price by differentiating with respect to an arbitrary scalar parameter and organizing the chain-rule terms into universal weights together with a single "weight-motion" correction channel. Distributional Sensitivity Engine (DSE) extends this engine viewpoint beyond the closed-form BSM setting for equity diffusions with deterministic term structures by rewriting the in-the-money event using a Doleans-Dade exponential of the stochastic integral and an associated Girsanov change of measure. Under the exponential-martingale condition (Appendix E) and the differentiation/regularity assumptions (Appendix F), the time-t price admits a two-weight form V_t=w_1 a_1+w_2 a_2 with F_t-measurable prefactors (a_1,a_2) and conditional "digital" weights under Q and Q^+. Differentiating this representation yields a four-input first-derivative engine V_(t,x)=∑_(k=1)^4 w_k  a_(k,x) whose weights depend only on conditional CDF/PDF blocks of the Doleans-Dade log variable E_(t,T) under the two measures. Mixed partials retain the same structure as in BSE: a dot product between common weights and second derivatives of primitives plus an explicit correction channel that collects products of first derivatives induced by weight dependence. This correction admits a matrix/Jacobian representation in terms of distributional Jacobian/Hessian blocks, providing an implementation-ready recipe once the conditional CDF/PDF blocks (and their parameter derivatives) are supplied by a numerical backend. In the deterministic-volatility BSM specialization these blocks reduce to normal CDF/PDF objects and the framework recovers the BSE Γ/vanna/volga-identified decomposition, providing closed-form regression targets for verification. The resulting separation of deterministic primitives from a probabilistic core suggests modular PDE or Monte Carlo implementations for the distributional blocks while keeping the sensitivity logic unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种敏感性计算引擎：BSM敏感性引擎（BSE）用于Black-Scholes-Merton模型，通过链式法则将一阶和二阶混合导数组织成通用权重和单一"权重运动"修正通道；分布敏感性引擎（DSE）将这一框架扩展到具有确定性期限结构的股票扩散模型，通过Doleans-Dade指数和Girsanov测度变换，将价格表示为两权重形式，其导数具有四输入结构，权重仅依赖于条件CDF/PDF块。
AI.research_question: 如何为金融衍生品定价模型构建统一、模块化的敏感性计算框架，使其既能处理封闭形式的BSM模型，又能扩展到更一般的扩散模型？
AI.motivation: 传统敏感性计算方法（如有限差分）在复杂模型中计算效率低下且数值不稳定，需要一种更系统、更高效的方法来计算金融衍生品价格对参数的导数，特别是对于风险管理和对冲策略至关重要的Gamma、Vanna、Volga等二阶敏感性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Black-Scholes-Merton模型、扩散过程理论、Doleans-Dade指数、Girsanov测度变换、链式法则微积分，以及条件概率分布（CDF/PDF）理论。
AI.method: 1. BSE：对BSM价格关于任意标量参数求导，将链式法则项组织成通用权重和单一修正通道；2. DSE：通过Doleans-Dade指数重写价内事件，应用Girsanov测度变换，在指数鞅条件和正则性假设下，将价格表示为两权重形式，然后推导其导数结构。
AI.findings: 1. BSE为BSM模型提供了紧凑的敏感性表示；2. DSE将框架扩展到一般扩散模型，价格可表示为V_t=w_1 a_1+w_2 a_2；3. 一阶导数具有四输入结构V_(t,x)=∑_(k=1)^4 w_k a_(k,x)；4. 混合偏导数保持与BSE相同的结构：公共权重与原始量二阶导数的点积加上显式修正通道；5. 修正通道可用分布雅可比/海森块表示。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了统一的敏感性计算引擎框架；2. 建立了从BSM到一般扩散模型的扩展理论；3. 发展了基于条件CDF/PDF块的模块化敏感性计算方法；4. 提供了混合偏导数的系统表示理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了实现就绪的敏感性计算配方；2. 支持模块化实现（PDE或蒙特卡洛）；3. 在确定性波动率BSM特例中恢复标准Gamma/Vanna/Volga分解；4. 为验证提供了封闭形式的回归目标；5. 分离了确定性原始量和概率核心，便于实际应用。

title: High-Frequency Trading and Price Discovery: The Role of Strategic Runs
affiliations: Goethe University Frankfurt

detail.title: High-Frequency Trading and Price Discovery: The Role of Strategic Runs
detail.abstract: Strategic runs are an outcome of high-frequency trading strategies that lead to alternating cycles of order submissions and cancellations within a short time interval. Examining granular limit order book data, we find that submissions and cancellations resulting from these runs have less permanent price impact and contribute less to price discovery than similar trading activities not part of a strategic run. Once other market participants can recognize that an order belongs to a strategic run, its contribution to price discovery diminishes significantly. Our findings indicate that such high-frequency trading activities do not enhance price discovery but rather dilute it by triggering a substantial number of orders with limited informational value.

AI.tldr: 高频交易策略产生的"战略性跑单"导致短时间内订单提交与取消的交替循环。研究发现，这些跑单产生的订单对价格发现的贡献较小，且一旦被市场参与者识别，其价格发现作用会显著减弱。
AI.research_question: 战略性跑单（高频交易策略导致的订单提交与取消循环）对价格发现有何影响？这些跑单产生的订单是否具有信息价值？
AI.motivation: 高频交易在现代金融市场中日益普遍，但其对市场质量（特别是价格发现）的实际影响仍存在争议。需要实证研究高频交易策略（如战略性跑单）是否真正促进价格发现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场微观结构理论，特别是价格发现理论、信息不对称理论和订单流信息含量理论。战略性跑单可能缺乏信息含量，对价格发现的贡献有限。
AI.method: 使用细粒度限价订单簿数据，分析战略性跑单中的订单提交与取消活动。比较跑单订单与非跑单订单的价格影响和价格发现贡献度。
AI.findings: 1. 战略性跑单产生的订单提交与取消具有较小的永久价格影响；2. 这些订单对价格发现的贡献小于非跑单的类似交易活动；3. 一旦市场参与者识别出订单属于战略性跑单，其对价格发现的贡献显著减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了高频交易对价格发现影响的实证证据；2. 区分了战略性跑单与非跑单订单的信息含量差异；3. 扩展了市场微观结构理论中关于订单流信息含量的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构评估高频交易对市场质量的影响提供依据；2. 帮助市场参与者识别和应对战略性跑单；3. 为交易所设计更有效的市场机制提供参考，以减少无信息含量的交易活动。

title: The Future Of Risk Is Predictive

detail.title: The Future Of Risk Is Predictive
detail.abstract: Delivered as the Riskonet Webinar on the 29th January 2026, the presentation launches the discussion on the top global and local risks for 2026. It asserts that the whilst the global top risk can be summarised as geopolitical instability with cascading economic and climate consequences and the local top risk as state fragility manifesting as infrastructure failure and governance breakdown, that in practice, the real global risk is the systemic breakdown across borders where shocks cascade faster that we can respond. It proposes that without the use of predictive tools, the speed at which risks manifest will continue to be a blind spot and weaken risk processes due to the increased complexity of today's risks environment.

AI.tldr: 该演讲分析了2026年全球和本地的主要风险，认为全球风险是地缘政治不稳定及其引发的经济和气候连锁反应，本地风险是国家脆弱性表现为基础设施失效和治理崩溃，但真正的全球风险是跨境系统性崩溃，冲击传播速度超过应对能力，需要预测工具来应对日益复杂的风险环境。
AI.research_question: 2026年全球和本地的主要风险是什么？如何应对跨境系统性崩溃风险？
AI.motivation: 当前风险环境日益复杂，冲击传播速度超过应对能力，传统风险管理方法存在盲点，需要新的工具和方法来预测和应对系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险理论、风险传播理论、地缘政治风险理论、国家脆弱性理论
AI.method: 基于专家分析和风险预测工具的演讲/讨论形式，通过Webinar进行风险识别和评估
AI.findings: 1. 2026年全球主要风险是地缘政治不稳定及其引发的经济和气候连锁反应；2. 本地主要风险是国家脆弱性表现为基础设施失效和治理崩溃；3. 真正的全球风险是跨境系统性崩溃，冲击传播速度超过应对能力；4. 缺乏预测工具会导致风险应对存在盲点
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了跨境系统性崩溃风险的概念框架，强调了风险传播速度超过应对能力这一关键理论观点，为风险管理理论提供了新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风险管理者提供了2026年风险预测，强调了预测工具的重要性，提出了应对系统性风险的实践建议，有助于改进风险管理流程。

title: The Political Economy of Natural Resources in the Caspian Sea region: Challenges for Transitions to Democracy
affiliations: Economic Research Center (ERC)

detail.title: The Political Economy of Natural Resources in the Caspian Sea region: Challenges for Transitions to Democracy
detail.abstract:
The political economy of natural resources[1] is not a new area of study, but focusing on the Caspian Basin countries, in particular, is a less-researched angle.  In this paper, I focus on three countries in the Caspian Sea region: Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, and Russia. While I had hoped also to consider the cases of Turkmenistan and Iran, there were problems with access to information for both countries.

A distinguishing feature of this article is my discussion of the significant role that the Caspian Sea region plays on the global stage. In particular, Russia’s recent aggression and attempt to change the political and administrative structure of the region, has garnered the attention of policymakers and researchers around the world. This paper will seek to evaluate the possible outcome of Russia’s actions in the region, as well as subsequent implications.

In this paper, I also attempt to estimate the result of falling oil prices and its impact on the behaviors of decision-makers and business people. The current economic context will therefore create new and interesting behavioral trends for further research and analysis.


[1] The political economy of natural resources[1] is means how natural assets affect the political system.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦里海盆地国家（阿塞拜疆、哈萨克斯坦、俄罗斯）的政治经济学，分析俄罗斯在该地区的扩张行为、油价下跌对决策者和商界人士的影响，以及该地区在全球舞台上的重要角色。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯在里海地区的扩张行为可能产生什么结果？油价下跌如何影响该地区决策者和商界人士的行为？
AI.motivation: 里海盆地国家的政治经济学研究相对不足，特别是俄罗斯近期在该地区的侵略行为引起了全球政策制定者和研究者的关注，需要深入分析其影响。同时，油价下跌为研究决策者和商界人士行为提供了新的经济背景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学理论，特别是自然资源政治经济学，探讨自然资源如何影响政治体系。关注地缘政治、经济决策行为等理论框架。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，聚焦阿塞拜疆、哈萨克斯坦和俄罗斯三个里海地区国家。由于信息获取限制，未包括土库曼斯坦和伊朗。
AI.findings: 论文将评估俄罗斯在里海地区行动的可能结果及其后续影响，分析油价下跌对决策者和商界人士行为的影响，识别当前经济背景下新的行为趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了里海盆地国家政治经济学的研究视角，为理解自然资源与政治体系的互动关系提供了区域案例，拓展了地缘政治理论在能源丰富地区的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于俄罗斯在里海地区扩张行为的可能结果分析，帮助商界人士理解油价波动下的决策环境，为区域稳定和发展提供参考依据。

reference: Richard D. Pomp, A Second Bite at the Apple, a Hail Mary, and a Rush to Judgment, 188 Tax Notes 767 (2025).
title: A Second Bite at the Apple, a Hail Mary, And a Rush to Judgment
affiliations: University of Connecticut - School of Law

detail.title: A Second Bite at the Apple, a Hail Mary, And a Rush to Judgment

publicationDetails.detailsText: Richard D. Pomp, A Second Bite at the Apple, a Hail Mary, and a Rush to Judgment, 188 Tax Notes 767 (2025).

detail.abstract:
In this article, Professor Pomp responds to recent commentary defending Maryland’s digital advertising tax against challenges under the Internet Tax Freedom Act’s (ITFA) nondiscrimination clause. He seeks to correct the record based on the evidence presented in recent Maryland Tax Court proceedings involving Peacock, Apple, and Google.

Maryland’s digital advertising tax is defended on the premise that online advertising is not similar to offline advertising, and thus does not violate ITFA’s nondiscrimination clause. This position hinges on a unique and unusual definition of digital advertising that appears neither in the Maryland statute nor anywhere else. The trial record shows that this definition was rejected under cross-examination, unsupported by industry or authoritative sources, and inconsistent with the state’s expert’s prior work. The state’s subsequent technical bulletin adopting that definition represents a bootstrap effort to obtain deference for last minute testimony.

The Internet Tax Freedom Act’s nondiscrimination prohibition is designed to provide broad protection for electronic commerce and, therefore, must be interpreted at a level of generality that focuses on substance rather than form. Whether online and offline advertising differ in technology, efficiency, or method of delivery is irrelevant; for purposes of discrimination analysis, “advertising is advertising.” A granular approach that emphasizes the form of the advertising is a narrow, granular approach with the result that online taxable advertising will almost never be comparable to offline exempt advertising, thereby rendering ITFA’s nondiscrimination clause meaningless.

Members of Congress understood that electronic commerce would be faster, better, more efficient, and nimbler than offline activity. They sought to avoid built-in obsolescence in a rapidly changing field. ITFA was enacted to foster, encourage, and safeguard anticipated innovations. It was not meant to allow states to use these very differences between online and offline commerce to justify discrimination. A granular, form-based approach flips ITFA on its head. It allows discrimination to be justified by the very innovations Congress sought to protect. It also invites ad hoc, fact-bound litigation in an advertising ecosystem where practices can change hourly or daily.

The article concludes that statutory interpretation and tax policy require a substance-based framework that compares taxable online and exempt offline advertising by their shared function: communicating a message to an audience. Treating all advertising services alike offers consistency, predictability, administrability, and protects reliance interests for states and taxpayers. This approach upholds Congress’s goal of ensuring a “tax-fair internet, not a tax-free one.”

AI.tldr: 本文回应了为马里兰州数字广告税辩护的观点，指出其基于一个独特且不寻常的数字广告定义，该定义既不在马里兰州法规中，也没有其他来源支持。文章主张应根据《互联网税收自由法》的非歧视条款，采用基于实质而非形式的解释框架，将所有广告服务视为相同，以维护国会保护电子商务创新的初衷。
AI.research_question: 马里兰州的数字广告税是否违反了《互联网税收自由法》的非歧视条款？
AI.motivation: 回应近期为马里兰州数字广告税辩护的评论，基于马里兰州税务法院最近涉及Peacock、Apple和Google的诉讼证据，纠正记录中的错误观点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 《互联网税收自由法》的非歧视条款解释理论；2. 税收政策中的实质重于形式原则；3. 电子商务保护与创新的立法意图理论。
AI.method: 法律分析与案例研究：分析马里兰州税务法院诉讼记录、法律条文解释、立法历史，以及税收政策原则的应用。
AI.findings: 1. 马里兰州辩护所依赖的数字广告定义是独特的、不寻常的，既不在法规中也没有权威来源支持；2. 该定义在交叉质证中被否定，且与州专家先前工作不一致；3. 技术公告采用该定义是为了获得对最后一刻证词的尊重；4. 应采用基于实质的框架，比较在线和离线广告的共同功能：向受众传达信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了解释《互联网税收自由法》非歧视条款的实质重于形式框架；2. 阐明了国会保护电子商务创新的立法意图；3. 论证了"广告就是广告"的税收平等原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为法院审理数字广告税案件提供分析框架；2. 帮助各州和纳税人获得一致性、可预测性和可管理性；3. 保护各州和纳税人的信赖利益；4. 维护国会"税收公平互联网，而非免税互联网"的目标。

title: Kantian Time as a Quantum Continuum: Structural Constraints in the Transcendental Aesthetic
affiliations: Newcastle University

detail.title: Kantian Time as a Quantum Continuum: Structural Constraints in the Transcendental Aesthetic

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No interests of conflict.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethical statement required.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding.

detail.abstract:
Kant's doctrine of time in the Critique of Pure Reason treats time as the pure form of inner sense and an a priori condition for representing succession, while denying that it is an object, a magnitude, or a feature of things in themselves. This combination of claims raises a structural problem. How can time be continuous, unified, and infinitely divisible without being reified or assimilated to a mathematical or physical continuum? 

This paper addresses that problem by offering a minimal axiomatic reconstruction of Kantian time using order-theoretic tools. Kant's core claims are captured by a small set of structural constraints governing a strict temporal order and a formal indexing of appearances. From these constraints, the paper derives both familiar Kantian results, such as the absence of first and last moments and the unity of temporal succession, and further consequences, including the exclusion of cyclical and branching temporal orders and the absence of intrinsic structure at temporal positions.

Under a natural regulative assumption concerning the finitude of appear- ances, the resulting temporal order admits an order-isomorphism with the rational line (Q, <). This result is diagnostic rather than classificatory. It shows that the continuity required for temporal awareness depends on density rather than metric completeness. Kantian time thus emerges as structurally continuous but ontologically thin, clarifying its distinctive position in debates about temporal continuity, structure, and idealism.

AI.tldr: 本文通过序论工具对康德时间观进行最小公理重构，证明康德时间具有结构性连续但本体论稀薄的特征，其连续性依赖于密度而非度量完备性。
AI.research_question: 康德的时间学说如何能在不被物化或同化为数学/物理连续统的情况下，保持连续性、统一性和无限可分性？
AI.motivation: 康德在《纯粹理性批判》中将时间视为内感官的纯粹形式和表象相继的先验条件，同时否认时间是对象、量度或物自体特征。这种主张组合引发了结构性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 康德的时间理论（作为内感官的纯粹形式）、序论（order theory）、结构连续性概念、本体论稀薄性（ontological thinness）
AI.method: 使用序论工具对康德时间观进行最小公理重构，通过一组结构约束来形式化严格时间顺序和现象的形式索引，并推导出康德时间的基本性质。
AI.findings: 1. 从公理约束可推导出康德熟悉的结果（无第一和最后时刻、时间相继的统一性）以及进一步结果（排除循环和分支时间顺序、时间位置无内在结构）。2. 在现象有限性的自然调节假设下，所得时间顺序与有理数线(Q, <)序同构。3. 时间意识所需的连续性依赖于密度而非度量完备性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 澄清康德时间作为"结构性连续但本体论稀薄"的独特地位。2. 为时间连续性、结构和唯心论辩论提供新视角。3. 展示序论工具在哲学分析中的诊断价值而非分类价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解康德时间理论提供精确的形式框架。2. 帮助哲学研究者更清晰地把握时间连续性的本质。3. 为相关哲学辩论提供方法论工具。

title: Neo-Schumpeterian Growth: Political and Religious Stability Matter
affiliations: ,  and Independent

detail.title: Neo-Schumpeterian Growth: Political and Religious Stability Matter

keywords: OECD members and candidates panel O30

detail.abstract: The purpose of this paper is to re-investigate one of the most prominent predictions of Neo-Schumpeterian growth theory-namely, that economic development is augmented by investments in R&D-by stressing that such a prediction applies only when conditional on institutional and sociocultural stability. To achieve this aim, an unbalanced panel data set of 23 OECD members and accession candidate countries from 1998 to 2018 is employed to estimate a Type III growth equation extended by interaction terms between R&D intensity and government/religious stability. Using a full set of macro controls and country-specific fixed effects, it is found that the marginal association of R&D and economic development strictly increases with institutional stability. Quantitatively, a 1-standard-deviation increase in R&D intensity is found to have a negligible association with GDP per capita when government stability is low but raises GDP per capita by up to 13.3% when government stability is high. Moreover, a symmetric relation is found such that a 1-standard-deviation increase in R&D intensity raises GDP per capita by up to 12.9% when religious stability is high. In contrast, the unconditional association between R&D and economic development is found to be small and statistically indistinguishable from zero when religious stability is low.

AI.tldr: 该研究重新检验新熊彼特增长理论的核心预测，发现R&D投资对经济发展的促进作用只有在制度和社会文化稳定的条件下才成立。基于23个OECD国家1998-2018年的面板数据分析，R&D与经济发展的边际关联随制度稳定性严格递增。
AI.research_question: R&D投资对经济发展的促进作用是否依赖于制度和社会文化稳定性？
AI.motivation: 新熊彼特增长理论强调R&D投资对经济增长的关键作用，但这一预测可能忽略了制度和社会文化环境的影响。本文旨在检验这一理论预测的条件性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新熊彼特增长理论（Neo-Schumpeterian growth theory），强调创新和R&D在经济增长中的核心作用。
AI.method: 使用23个OECD成员国和候选国1998-2018年的非平衡面板数据，估计扩展的Type III增长方程，包含R&D强度与政府稳定性/宗教稳定性的交互项，采用全套宏观控制变量和国家固定效应。
AI.findings: 1. R&D与经济发展的边际关联随制度稳定性严格递增；2. 当政府稳定性低时，R&D强度增加1个标准差对人均GDP影响可忽略；3. 当政府稳定性高时，R&D强度增加1个标准差可使人均GDP提高13.3%；4. 宗教稳定性高时，类似效应为12.9%；5. 宗教稳定性低时，R&D与经济发展的无条件关联小且统计上不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为新熊彼特增长理论提供了条件性解释；2. 强调制度和社会文化稳定性作为R&D促进经济发展的关键边界条件；3. 丰富了创新与经济增长关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供启示：单纯增加R&D投资不足以促进经济发展，需要同时改善制度和社会文化稳定性；2. 帮助国家更有效地配置创新资源；3. 为国际组织评估创新政策效果提供新视角。

title: Trade Policy Uncertainty and Trade in the Short Run: An Empirical Investigation of the Reciprocal Tariff

detail.title: Trade Policy Uncertainty and Trade in the Short Run: An Empirical Investigation of the Reciprocal Tariff
detail.abstract: This paper examines the short run effects of trade policy uncertainty (TPU) arising from the U.S. Reciprocal Tariff announcement. Using monthly import data, we find that U.S. firms increased imports from countries facing higher TPU. Contrary to conventional views that TPU suppresses trade, our results highlight a distinct short run importer response consistent with recent inventory management theories. This study offers one of the first empirical assessments of the Reciprocal Tariff's impact and contributes to understanding how firms react to trade policy uncertainty in the short term.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，美国互惠关税公告引发的贸易政策不确定性（TPU）在短期内反而促使美国企业增加了从面临较高TPU国家的进口，这与传统认为TPU抑制贸易的观点相反。
AI.research_question: 美国互惠关税公告引发的贸易政策不确定性（TPU）在短期内对美国企业进口行为有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为贸易政策不确定性会抑制贸易，但缺乏对短期企业反应的实证研究。美国互惠关税公告为研究TPU的短期影响提供了自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于库存管理理论，企业可能在面临贸易政策不确定性时增加进口以建立库存，避免未来关税上涨带来的成本增加。
AI.method: 使用月度进口数据，分析美国互惠关税公告后企业进口行为的变化，特别关注面临不同TPU水平的国家。
AI.findings: 美国企业增加了从面临较高贸易政策不确定性国家的进口，这与传统TPU抑制贸易的观点相反，但与库存管理理论一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统贸易政策不确定性抑制贸易的观点，为库存管理理论在贸易政策反应中的应用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解企业短期应对贸易政策不确定性的行为提供了实证依据，有助于预测贸易政策变化的市场反应。

title: TECH GIANT EXCLUSION
affiliations: Seattle University School of Law

detail.title: TECH GIANT EXCLUSION
detail.abstract: There is no topic in regulatory policy that is more pressing and more controversial than what to do about the tech giants-Google, Facebook, Amazon, and Apple. Critics claim that these powerful platforms crush competitors, distort the political process, and elude antitrust law because the law cares only about consumer prices. The only solution, critics argue, is to break them up. The tech giants have indeed engaged in anticompetitive conduct. They have excluded rivals selling products on their platforms by demoting them in search results, copying their products, or refusing to deal with them. While these tactics have harmed consumers, they have never been successfully challenged because they have rarely, if ever, created monopoly power or a dangerous probability of monopoly power, which the Sherman Act requires. This requirement should be eliminated. The tech giants should not be broken up. Splitting them into smaller versions of themselves would result in higher prices or lower quality. Preventing them from selling their own products on their platforms would deprive consumers of choices they value. Nor should the goals of antitrust law be changed. The fundamental aim of antitrust law is to protect consumers and vulnerable suppliers-such as workers-from anticompetitive conduct. If courts also had to focus on preserving small business and limiting the political influence of large firms, the goals of antitrust would conflict. Courts would have no objective way of resolving the conflict, the rule of law would suffer, and consumers and workers would be hurt. Congress should instead amend the Sherman Act to prohibit exclusionary conduct that significantly reduces competition, whether or not it results in actual or probable monopoly power. To avoid chilling procompetitive conduct, the change should apply only to the tech giants and should contain strict proof requirements. This careful expansion would make it much easier to deter tech giant exclusion that harms consumers or workers.

detail.abstract: We study the transmission of credit supply shocks to firms by exploiting the unexpected exit of the third-largest lender in the Irish business lending market in 2020 and a unique matched firm-lender dataset that covers both banks and nonbank financial institutions. We find that borrowers of the exiting bank receive less credit along both the extensive and intensive margin in the period after the announcement, highlighting that credit supply is not perfectly substitutable across lenders. However, we show that this negative credit supply shock is partly mitigated by non-bank lenders. Borrowers of the exiting bank are more likely to borrow from non-banks following the shock, with the effects driven by business loan facilities, and stronger among riskier firms.

detail.title: Marketing the Sustainability Initiatives in India: The Status of Green-House Gas Emissions (GHGs) and the Carbon Market

detail.abstract: This study examines domestic and international efforts to market sustainability initiatives by examining the state of GHG emissions and the development of the carbon market, with a particular emphasis on India. International accords, starting with the 1972 Stockholm Conference and ending with the legally binding emission reduction targets set by the Kyoto Protocol (1997), were prompted by global concerns over resource overuse and ensuing climate shifts. The Emissions Trading System (ETS), Clean Development Mechanism (CDM), and Joint Implementation (JI) are the three crucial market-based mechanisms that were developed by the Protocol to solve environmental market failure by internalizing the societal cost of pollution. By creating Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) and mandating that all parties, especially developing countries, commit to aggressive carbon reduction targets, the ensuing 2015 Paris Agreement solidified this direction. An analysis of India's industrial landscape's Global Warming Potentials (GWP) between 2005 and 2018 shows alarming patterns, including an almost universal increase across industries. Importantly, GWP increases of more than 268% were recorded in sectors like Non-Ferrous Metals, Other Energy Industries, and Chemicals & Fertilizers. With 36 nations implementing ETS and 39 enacting national carbon taxes, the use of carbon pricing schemes has increased globally. But taken as a whole, these tools only account for 24% of world emissions. Although the European Union ETS is the largest compliance market in the world, major compliance markets such as China and New Zealand saw substantial price fluctuation in the early months of 2025, which raised concerns about the stability and effectiveness of the market. By tokenizing carbon credits and turning them into digital assets on block chain systems, as demonstrated by exchanges like Toucan Protocol, the industry is also seeing technological advancement. India has introduced the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS), 2023 in accordance with its NDC pledge to reduce carbon emissions by 45% by 2030 (compared to 2005 levels) and achieve net-zero emissions by 2070. The Grid Controller of India (GCI) and the Central Electrical Regulatory Commission (CERC) oversee registry and trade operations, respectively, while the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) administers the CCTS. National carbon neutrality programs that concentrate on afforestation, clean air projects, and the creation of Carbon Capture Utilization and Storage (CCUS) frameworks to alleviate the industry's excessive reliance on coal are employed in conjunction with these efforts. The paper advocates for a community-involved, government-regulated system for the payment and control of CO2 emitters, arguing that a more comprehensive and effective regulation model may need to go beyond merely market-oriented measures in order to assure true sustainability.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how euro-area (EA) interest rates react to EA and US macroeconomic surprises. We find that the sensitivity of interest rates to surprises varies across tenors and over time. Short-term OIS rates are significantly less sensitive to macroeconomic surprises than longer-term rates. During the forward guidance period (2013-22), interest rate reactivity was rather muted, especially at the short end of the yield curve. Term premia accounted almost entirely for the sensitivity observed at the long end of the curve. Since the ECB’s adoption of a data-dependent and meeting-by-meeting approach, interest rate sensitivity has forcefully surged back to the levels observed during the Great Financial Crisis. In particular, EA OIS rates have become highly sensitive to US surprises, thus pointing to significant spillovers from US economic developments to EA financial conditions. Monetary policy uncertainty amplifies the sensitivity of interest rates to surprises, especially to those related to US economic developments and for the expected short term rate component.

detail.abstract: Enhancing innovation and productivity is a primary challenge for the European economy. To achieve this goal, it is essential to step up investment in innovative projects. Advancing the integration of capital markets, a key objective of the Savings and Investment Union, can be pivotal in this effort by reducing financing costs and strengthening the investment ecosystem. We argue that the integration of European capital markets – including the introduction of a common European safe asset – could raise investment levels by approximately 1 per cent of GDP. Over a ten-year horizon this would raise GDP by 1.5 per cent. If additional investment were focused on R&D spending, the impact would be three times as great.

detail.abstract: The Iran-Israel War of 2025 marks a historic rupture in Middle Eastern geopolitics, transitioning from covert proxy confrontations to overt stateto-state warfare. This article explores how the conflict has aggravated an unprecedented humanitarian crisis, especially in Gaza, while simultaneously exposing the erosion of international norms and institutions. The analysis exposes the selective application of international law, the impotence of the Responsibility to Protect (R2P) doctrine, and the failure of institutions like the UN to uphold global justice. The authors critique simplistic frameworks such as Huntington's "Clash of Civilizations", arguing instead for a nuanced understanding of the geopolitical, economic, and humanitarian ramifications of the war.

detail.abstract: The relevance of the study is conditioned by the investigation and delineation of counterintelligence powers of border authorities and units of Ukraine in different historical periods, determining the areas of their development. The paper is devoted to the study of historical aspects of the development of counterintelligence activities of border agencies, and national and state security bodies on the territory of Ukraine, in particular, the history of transformation of the relevant units and their powers. It is noted that the study of the history of the establishment and functioning of national special services is of practical importance and can become relevant when adjusting the national security strategy. The purpose of the study is to analyse the historical aspects of the development of counterintelligence activities and counterintelligence measures by border authorities and units on the territory of Ukraine in light of retrospective changes in national special services. The methodology of scientific research included a set of interrelated general scientific and historical and legal methods, namely: chronological – to periodise the development of counterintelligence authorities and units of national special services, and the border guard service; comparative legal analysis – a comparative approach to the past and modern legislation, which determines the authority to carry out counterintelligence activities or conduct counterintelligence measures; structural and functional – to classify the threat system, which is carried out by active measures of the main enemy. Features of the legal status of border authorities and divisions of Ukraine in different historical periods are highlighted. It is indicated on the main counterintelligence methods (measures) that were carried out by authorised state bodies and units, namely: the legendary method of capturing prisoners to be interrogated, first mentioned in the annals of the Kievan Rus and conducted mainly during military campaigns; perlustration (interception) of correspondence and external surveillance, their conduct is most characteristic of the period of the Russian occupation; agent measures, during the first liberation competitions, were consolidated in the legal field by the relevant provision, which specifies the main functions of the army special service of the Ukrainian People’s Republic; operational surveillance, legend and operational disinformation (used by both the security service of the organisation of Ukrainian nationalists and Soviet state security agencies). Based on the studies by Ukrainian and foreign researchers, a classification of “active measures” that can be carried out by the aggressor state is presented. The areas of development of the powers of bodies and divisions of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine to conduct counterintelligence activities are determined.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了乌克兰边境机构在不同历史时期反情报权力的演变，探讨了从基辅罗斯时期到现代的反情报方法发展，并确定了国家边境警卫队反情报活动权力发展的方向。
AI.research_question: 乌克兰边境机构和单位在不同历史时期的反情报权力如何演变？这些权力发展的方向是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究乌克兰边境机构反情报活动的历史发展具有实际重要性，可为调整国家安全战略提供参考。了解国家特殊服务机构的建立和运作历史对当前安全政策制定有指导意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史法律分析框架，结合比较法律分析和结构功能方法，用于分类威胁系统和分析反情报方法。
AI.method: 采用一系列相互关联的一般科学和历史法律方法：1) 年代学方法 - 用于划分反情报机构和边境警卫服务的发展时期；2) 比较法律分析 - 比较过去和现代立法；3) 结构功能方法 - 对威胁系统进行分类。
AI.findings: 1) 确定了不同历史时期乌克兰边境机构的特殊法律地位；2) 识别了主要反情报方法：俘虏审讯（基辅罗斯时期）、信件拦截和外部监视（俄罗斯占领时期）、代理人措施（乌克兰人民共和国时期）、行动监视和虚假信息（乌克兰民族主义者组织和苏联国家安全机构使用）；3) 基于研究提出了侵略国可能采取的"积极措施"分类；4) 确定了乌克兰国家边境警卫队进行反情报活动的权力发展方向。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了乌克兰边境机构反情报权力发展的历史分期框架；2) 提出了反情报方法的类型学分类；3) 发展了威胁系统分类的理论模型；4) 为比较历史法律分析提供了方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为调整乌克兰国家安全战略提供历史参考；2) 帮助识别当前边境安全威胁；3) 指导边境警卫队反情报能力建设；4) 为立法改革提供历史依据；5) 增强对侵略国"积极措施"的防范意识。

title: Keep on Trading in the Free World 1

detail.title: Keep on Trading in the Free World 1
detail.abstract: In 2016 the world was rocked by two startling events: the election of Donald Trump in the United States and Brexit in the United Kingdom. While it would be imprudent to put forward simplistic, one-dimensional explanations, both outcomes seem to represent, to some extent, an electoral red card to the 'liberal internationalism' that shaped the world economy over the last decades. On both sides of the Atlantic, many citizens are voicing concerns over the drawbacks of free trade and the globalization process more broadly. This public disquiet is not unprecedented. What is new is how populist candidates used this anxiety with unexpected electoral success. Populist politicians condemn the 'liberal internationalism' that they associate with economic globalization, in particular the promotion of instruments of supranational integration and regulation, trade and investment treaties, etc. (Thompson 2017) Both Brexit and Trump's victory are linked to the conviction that internationally agreed upon rules, multilateralism, and globalization constrain and obstruct national interests (Harris 2016). The electoral emergence of political groups that capitalize on citizens' feelings of economic insecurity has been portrayed as the largest threat to free trade since the Second World War (The Economist 2015). Trump made the protection of domestic interests the hallmark of his Administration, putting an end to a time-honored tradition of American internationalism.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了2016年特朗普当选和英国脱欧如何代表对"自由国际主义"的选举红牌，分析民粹主义政客如何利用公众对全球化的焦虑获得选举成功，以及这对自由贸易和多边主义的威胁。
AI.research_question: 民粹主义政治如何利用公众对全球化的焦虑获得选举成功，以及这对自由国际主义和国际经济秩序意味着什么？
AI.motivation: 2016年特朗普当选和英国脱欧这两个重大政治事件揭示了公众对自由国际主义和全球化进程的强烈不满，需要理解民粹主义如何利用这种不满获得政治成功。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自由国际主义理论、全球化理论、民粹主义政治理论、国际经济秩序理论
AI.method: 理论分析、案例研究（特朗普当选和英国脱欧）、文献综述
AI.findings: 民粹主义政客成功利用公众对全球化的焦虑，将自由国际主义与负面经济后果联系起来；特朗普和脱欧运动都代表了民族主义对多边主义的挑战；这标志着美国长期国际主义传统的终结。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对民粹主义与全球化关系的理解；提出了"选举红牌"概念来描述对自由国际主义的政治反弹；分析了民粹主义如何重构国际经济话语。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解反全球化情绪提供框架；警示自由贸易和多边主义面临的威胁；为国际组织应对民粹主义挑战提供参考。

title: Remineralization and Mobilization in the European Southwest Periphery
affiliations: Universidad Pablo de Olavide and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Remineralization and Mobilization in the European Southwest Periphery
detail.abstract: The European energy transition is driving a renewed expansion of mining activities framed as sustainable, strategic, and technologically advanced. This article critically examines this process through the concept of remineralization, defined as the reactivation of extractive frontiers in territories shaped by long-standing pollution legacies, regulatory continuities, and socio-environmental conflict. Drawing on Ecological Economics and political ecology, the paper challenges dominant narratives of “green” mining that portray current extractive expansion as a rupture with past practices.Empirically, the analysis focuses on the European southwest periphery, with particular attention to Andalusia (Spain), a region that has become a testing ground for Europe’s renewed mining agenda. The study is based on twenty-four mining-related conflicts identified through the Map of Mining Environmental Conflicts of Andalusia and Portugal, combining archival research, fieldwork, and conflict mapping. We analyse conflicts by distinguishing structural factors, environmental triggers, and socio-political drivers across multiple spatial and temporal scales. Some relevant cases had their origin during the mining boom under the Franco dictatorship.The findings reveal that accelerated permitting, public-interest exemptions, and green-growth discourses associated with the European Critical Raw Materials Act intensify socio-environmental vulnerability rather than resolve it. At the same time, grassroots mobilizations, legal strategies, and alliances with scientific expertise play a central role in contesting extractivist logics and articulating alternative, post-extractive futures. The article contributes to Ecological Economics by extending debates on extractivism, environmental justice, and valuation conflicts to the European context, highlighting the importance of historical legacies and collective resistance in shaping contemporary mining governance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"再矿化"概念批判性分析欧洲能源转型中的采矿扩张，揭示所谓"绿色"采矿延续而非打破历史污染、监管连续性和社会冲突的模式，强调基层抵抗在塑造后采掘未来中的关键作用。
AI.research_question: 欧洲能源转型中的"绿色"采矿扩张如何延续历史遗留问题并加剧社会-环境脆弱性？基层抵抗如何挑战采掘主义逻辑并塑造替代性未来？
AI.motivation: 欧洲能源转型推动的采矿扩张被包装为可持续、战略性和技术先进的"绿色"采矿，但缺乏对历史连续性、监管延续性和社会冲突的批判性分析，需要揭示其真实影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态经济学和政治生态学，特别是"再矿化"概念（在长期污染遗产、监管连续性和社会-环境冲突的领土上重新激活采掘前沿）。
AI.method: 基于安达卢西亚和葡萄牙采矿环境冲突地图识别的24个采矿相关冲突，结合档案研究、实地调查和冲突映射，分析结构因素、环境触发因素和社会政治驱动因素。
AI.findings: 欧洲关键原材料法案相关的加速许可、公共利益豁免和绿色增长话语加剧而非解决社会-环境脆弱性；基层动员、法律策略和科学专业知识联盟在挑战采掘主义逻辑和构建后采掘未来中发挥核心作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将采掘主义、环境正义和估值冲突的辩论扩展到欧洲背景，强调历史遗产和集体抵抗在当代采矿治理中的重要性，丰富了生态经济学的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供对"绿色"采矿话语的批判视角，揭示加速许可和公共利益豁免的风险；为基层运动提供抵抗策略和替代发展路径的实证支持。

title: Local Development Policy Effects on Environmental Quality: The Case of Amathole District Municipality

detail.title: Local Development Policy Effects on Environmental Quality: The Case of Amathole District Municipality

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Sustainability has become an increasingly significant issue, although practical implementation remains difficult. Pressure from the Constitution’s developmental obligations on local government presents teething problems in South Africa, hampering the transitioning to sustainability especially at sub-national levels, where increased amounts of resources are required to supplement expertise amid negative effects of incoherent efforts and disaggregated planning rendering it difficult to attain minimum levels of sustainability in line with global efforts else. Data gathering on local environmental conditions is haphazard making it impossible for policy makers to have meaningful knowledge of baseline environmental conditions. This study galvanized professionals and academics in the EC province to develop environmental quality indicators, gathering of data on Amathole District’s environmental conditions to conduct an assessment using Multi Criteria Analysis (MCA) with aim to stimulate the municipalities under its legislative authority to implement sustainable policies and comply with national objectives. Pursuant to this endeavour, the state of the environment in the 6 local municipalities of the district evaluated using 25 locally relevant indicators. The values of the indicators have been used to rank the municipalities by multiple criteria analysis (MCA). The results of this comparative approach provide information about the level of sustainability attained in the district as a whole as well as in the individual local municipalities. The objective is for a transparent and objective self-assessment and reporting that will provide the basis for remedial action locally, as recommended by Agenda 21, and the SA National framework on Environmental Sustainability.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过开发环境质量指标，对南非Amathole地区的6个地方自治市进行多标准分析评估，旨在促进可持续政策的实施和符合国家目标。
AI.research_question: 如何评估南非Amathole地区地方自治市的环境可持续性水平，并为政策制定提供透明客观的基础？
AI.motivation: 南非地方层面可持续发展实施困难，宪法发展义务给地方政府带来压力，环境数据收集零散，政策制定者缺乏基线环境条件的有效知识，阻碍了可持续发展目标的实现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展理论、多标准分析（MCA）方法、环境质量指标框架、Agenda 21和南非国家环境可持续性框架。
AI.method: 开发25个本地相关环境质量指标，收集Amathole地区环境数据，采用多标准分析（MCA）对6个地方自治市进行评估和排名。
AI.findings: 通过比较分析提供了整个地区及各个地方自治市的可持续性水平信息，建立了透明客观的自我评估和报告基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了适用于南非地方层面的环境可持续性评估框架，将多标准分析方法应用于地方环境治理，为可持续发展理论在实践中的应用提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府提供了具体的环境质量指标和评估工具，支持可持续政策的制定和实施，促进符合国家目标和Agenda 21的补救行动，增强了地方环境治理能力。

title: Predictive Model for Sustainable Exploitation of Geothermal Resources in Africa: The Case of Olkaria Geothermal Field
affiliations: University of Florence, University of Florence, Independent, Independent, Strathmore University and Strathmore University

detail.title: Predictive Model for Sustainable Exploitation of Geothermal Resources in Africa: The Case of Olkaria Geothermal Field

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: The work came out of a collaboration between the various entities through the European project LEAP-RE [H2020 No 963530] (http s://www.leap-re.eu/) specifically under Working Package 9 Geothermal Atlas for Africa (https://www.leap-re.eu/geothermal-atlas4-africa/).

detail.abstract: Geothermal energy is a crucial renewable resource for a sustainable future, especially in African nations cut by the Rift Valley, which holds vast untapped potential. However, high upfront costs and development risks remain key challenges. This study introduces a simplified model calibrated with real data from Kenya's Olkaria geothermal field. The model enables rapid preliminary assessments of both technical and economic performance, requiring minimal input data. Additionally, it incorporates a Life Cycle Assessment to evaluate environmental impacts, an aspect rarely explored in African geothermal studies. The research analyses various technological configurations, including Single Flash, Double Flash, and Organic Rankine Cycle (ORC) systems, aiming to improve efficiency without additional drilling. Findings show that integrating an ORC with existing flash systems can boost energy output by up to 20.1 %, with only a modest rise in the Levelized Cost of Electricity. Compared to the current Olkaria IV setup, hybrid systems demonstrated lower carbon emissions and reduced material resource use per energy output. Results confirm that ORC integration offers the most sustainable pathway for developing high-temperature geothermal resources in the East African Rift. This approach balances energy efficiency, economic feasibility, and environmental impact, providing valuable guidance for future power plant development in regulatory-constrained settings. This work is fully consistent with the objectives of Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) 7 and 13.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个简化的地热评估模型，结合肯尼亚Olkaria地热田实际数据，分析不同技术配置（单闪蒸、双闪蒸、有机朗肯循环）的技术经济性能和环境效益。研究发现ORC集成可将能源输出提升20.1%，同时降低碳排放和材料消耗，为东非裂谷带地热开发提供了可持续路径。
AI.research_question: 如何通过技术集成（特别是ORC系统）提高东非裂谷带高温地热资源的开发效率，同时平衡经济可行性和环境影响？
AI.motivation: 非洲裂谷带拥有巨大的未开发地热潜力，但高昂的前期成本和开发风险阻碍了其利用。现有研究很少评估非洲地热项目的环境影响，需要开发简化的评估工具来支持初步决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术经济分析和生命周期评估理论框架，结合地热发电技术（闪蒸系统和ORC系统）的工程原理，构建综合评估模型。
AI.method: 开发简化模型，使用肯尼亚Olkaria地热田实际数据进行校准，分析单闪蒸、双闪蒸和ORC系统配置，结合生命周期评估方法评价环境影响。
AI.findings: ORC与现有闪蒸系统集成可将能源输出提升20.1%，平准化电力成本仅有适度增加。混合系统相比当前Olkaria IV配置具有更低的碳排放和单位能源输出的材料消耗。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了适用于非洲地热开发的简化评估框架，将技术经济分析与生命周期评估相结合，填补了非洲地热环境评估研究的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为东非裂谷带地热开发提供了具体的技术路径（ORC集成），为监管约束环境下的电站规划提供决策支持，有助于实现可持续发展目标7和13。

title: A Comprehensive Quantitative Evaluation of Global Finance Research: Institutions, Scholars, and Citations
affiliations: Western Kentucky University - Department of Accounting and Finance, Shanghai Business School,  and

detail.title: A Comprehensive Quantitative Evaluation of Global Finance Research: Institutions, Scholars, and Citations

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in Review of Quantitative Finance and Accounting

detail.abstract: We conduct a global citation-based assessment of finance research from 28 finance journals published between 1990 and 2024. Our results show a substantial increase in the impact of finance research over time, and highly influential articles are concentrated in leading journals such as the Journal of Finance, Journal of Financial Economics, and Review of Financial Studies. The University of Chicago, Harvard University, New York University, the University of Pennsylvania, and Columbia University are top contributors at the institutional level. For top scholars, Eugene F. Fama, Kenneth R. French, and Andrei Shleifer stand out as the top-three scholars, amassing 3,908.08, 3,208.32, and 2,309.93 weighted normalized citations, respectively. For the total number of articles, Iftekhar Hasan, Frank J. Fabozzi, and Robert W. Faff lead the pack with 136, 126, and 119 articles, respectively. Finally, there is an expanding involvement of emerging economies and non-academic organizations, highlighting the increasing diversity and globalization of finance research.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对1990-2024年间28个金融期刊的引用分析，评估了金融研究的全球影响力。研究发现金融研究影响力随时间显著增长，顶级文章集中在《金融杂志》《金融经济学杂志》《金融研究评论》等顶尖期刊。芝加哥大学、哈佛大学等机构是主要贡献者，Fama、French、Shleifer是引用最高的学者，Hasan、Fabozzi、Faff是发文量最多的学者。新兴经济体和非学术组织的参与度增加，显示金融研究日益多样化和全球化。
AI.research_question: 1990-2024年间全球金融研究的引用影响力如何变化？哪些期刊、机构和学者对金融研究领域贡献最大？金融研究的多样性和全球化趋势如何发展？
AI.motivation: 需要对金融研究领域进行全面的影响力评估，了解该领域的发展趋势、核心贡献者和全球化进程，为学术界和政策制定者提供参考依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于引文分析理论，使用加权标准化引用次数作为影响力衡量指标，结合机构贡献度和学者生产力分析框架。
AI.method: 对1990-2024年间28个金融期刊的文章进行全球引用分析，计算加权标准化引用次数，统计机构贡献度和学者生产力数据。
AI.findings: 1) 金融研究影响力随时间显著增长；2) 顶级文章集中在JF、JFE、RFS等顶尖期刊；3) 芝加哥大学、哈佛大学、纽约大学等是主要贡献机构；4) Fama、French、Shleifer是引用最高的学者；5) Hasan、Fabozzi、Faff是发文量最多的学者；6) 新兴经济体和非学术组织参与度增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了金融研究领域影响力的系统评估框架，建立了基于引文分析的领域发展评估方法，为研究影响力评估理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学者选择发表期刊提供参考，为机构评估研究影响力提供依据，为政策制定者了解金融研究发展趋势提供数据支持，反映了金融研究的全球化趋势。

reference: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 960
title: The Macroeconomic Effects of Import Tariffs on the Euro Area: A Model-Based Assessment
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: The Macroeconomic Effects of Import Tariffs on the Euro Area: A Model-Based Assessment

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 960
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We use a multi-country New Keynesian model of the global economy to assess the macroeconomic effects on the euro area (EA) of an increase in tariffs on U.S. (US) imports, either unilaterally or with retaliatory tariffs by the EA, China (CH) and the rest of the world (RW). Our results are as follows. First, EA output decreases to a larger extent (slightly more than 1% at the trough) under the retaliation scenario than under that of an increase in US tariffs with no retaliation (0.5%). The additional decrease is due to the drop in domestic aggregate demand, only partially offset by the increase in exports to CH. Second, an increase in global trade policy uncertainty reduces aggregate demand and, thus, has recessionary and disinflationary effects on the EA and global economies (EA GDP falls by 1%). We also consider a portfolio rebalancing towards financial assets issued by the EA, CH, the RW. This would induce a depreciation of the US dollar and (modest) expansionary and disinflationary effects on countries other than the US.

AI.tldr: 本文使用多国新凯恩斯模型评估美国提高关税对欧元区的宏观经济影响，比较了单边关税与欧元区、中国及世界其他地区报复性关税两种情景。研究发现报复性关税导致欧元区产出下降更严重（约1%），主要因国内总需求下降，仅部分被对中国出口增加所抵消。全球贸易政策不确定性会降低总需求，对欧元区和全球经济产生衰退和通缩效应。此外，投资组合向欧元区、中国及其他地区金融资产再平衡会导致美元贬值，对美国以外国家产生温和扩张和通缩效应。
AI.research_question: 美国提高进口关税对欧元区宏观经济的影响如何？报复性关税与单边关税情景下的影响有何差异？全球贸易政策不确定性及投资组合再平衡如何影响欧元区经济？
AI.motivation: 随着全球贸易紧张局势加剧，特别是美国贸易政策变化，需要评估这些政策对欧元区等主要经济体的宏观经济影响，为政策制定者提供决策依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多国新凯恩斯主义模型，该框架结合了价格粘性、不完全竞争和货币政策规则等特征，适用于分析全球贸易政策冲击的跨国传导机制。
AI.method: 采用多国新凯恩斯动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型，模拟美国单边提高关税与欧元区、中国及世界其他地区实施报复性关税两种情景，并进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 1. 报复性关税情景下欧元区产出下降幅度更大（约1%），单边关税情景下降幅约0.5%；2. 额外下降主要源于国内总需求下降，仅部分被对中国出口增加所抵消；3. 全球贸易政策不确定性会降低总需求，对欧元区和全球经济产生衰退和通缩效应（欧元区GDP下降1%）；4. 投资组合向欧元区、中国及其他地区金融资产再平衡会导致美元贬值，对美国以外国家产生温和扩张和通缩效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了新凯恩斯模型在分析全球贸易政策冲击中的应用，特别关注了报复性关税的跨国传导机制，以及贸易政策不确定性通过总需求渠道对宏观经济的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化评估贸易政策影响的工具，表明报复性关税对各方均不利，支持通过多边协调解决贸易争端；同时提示贸易政策不确定性本身具有经济成本，应努力降低不确定性。

title: Synchronization as Manipulation
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Synchronization as Manipulation
detail.abstract: We analyze how coordination manipulation distorts information aggregation in prediction markets. Unlike traditional misinformation, a strategic manipulator exploits traders' sequential awareness structure by releasing synchronized batches of truthful information to create an artificial impression of common knowledge. Modeling a platform that detects such temporal clustering patterns, we characterize a unique equilibrium featuring preemption and show that: (i) undetected coordination creates higher-order adverse selection, expanding bid-ask spreads by a first-order magnitude that is robustly positive across all priors; (ii) a deterrence threshold exists above which manipulation is unprofitable; (iii) increasing detection improves informational efficiency if and only if the residual coordination distortion dominates the informational loss from truthful signals. The model reframes the policy debate from content veracity to timing transparency.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了协调操纵如何扭曲预测市场的信息聚合。与传统虚假信息不同，战略操纵者利用交易者的顺序意识结构，通过发布同步的真实信息批次来制造人为的共识印象。研究发现：未检测到的协调会产生高阶逆向选择，显著扩大买卖价差；存在威慑阈值使操纵无利可图；提高检测效率仅在剩余协调扭曲主导真实信号信息损失时改善信息效率。
AI.research_question: 协调操纵如何扭曲预测市场的信息聚合？协调操纵与传统虚假信息有何不同？平台检测时间聚类模式对市场效率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统对市场操纵的研究主要关注虚假信息，但现实中操纵者可能通过协调发布真实信息的时间来制造虚假共识印象。这种基于时间协调的新型操纵方式对预测市场信息聚合的影响尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于博弈论和信息经济学框架，特别是顺序意识结构、协调操纵、高阶逆向选择、预测市场信息聚合理论。
AI.method: 建立理论模型分析协调操纵对预测市场的影响，包括：1) 建模平台检测时间聚类模式；2) 刻画具有先发制人特征的独特均衡；3) 分析不同参数条件下的市场效率。
AI.findings: 1) 未检测到的协调会产生高阶逆向选择，使买卖价差扩大一阶幅度，且在所有先验下都稳健为正；2) 存在威慑阈值，超过该阈值操纵无利可图；3) 提高检测效率仅在剩余协调扭曲主导真实信号信息损失时改善信息效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出协调操纵的新概念，区别于传统虚假信息操纵；2) 建立时间协调操纵的理论模型；3) 揭示高阶逆向选择机制；4) 将政策辩论从内容真实性转向时间透明度。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为平台设计检测时间聚类模式提供理论依据；2) 为监管者制定市场操纵政策提供新视角；3) 帮助市场参与者识别和防范协调操纵风险；4) 强调时间透明度在维护市场效率中的重要性。

reference: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 961
title: The Effects of Monetary Policy on Gross Domestic Product, Investment and Inflation: An Analysis of Italian Regional Heterogeneity
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy and Bank of Italy

detail.title: The Effects of Monetary Policy on Gross Domestic Product, Investment and Inflation: An Analysis of Italian Regional Heterogeneity

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 961
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the impact of the ECB’s monetary policy on Italian regional economies and seeks to identify and explain the heterogeneous effects across regions by focusing on gross domestic product, investment, and inflation. The approach is empirical and involves two stages. First, we estimate impulse response functions at regional level and test for the presence of heterogeneity. Second, we explore the underlying drivers of heterogeneity using synthetic indicators that capture the key structural characteristics of local industrial and banking systems. The analysis uncovers statistically significant heterogeneity. Furthermore, a substantial share of the variance in the responses is explained by differences in the strength of regional industrial structures. The financial fragility of firms and the share of small banks in local credit systems also contribute to explaining the observed heterogeneity, albeit to a lesser extent.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了欧洲央行货币政策对意大利区域经济的影响，发现存在显著的异质性效应，主要受区域产业结构强度差异驱动，企业财务脆弱性和小型银行占比也有一定解释力。
AI.research_question: 欧洲央行的货币政策如何影响意大利各区域经济？区域间存在怎样的异质性效应？这些异质性的驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策在区域层面的传导机制差异，识别影响政策效果的结构性因素，为区域经济政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制理论、区域经济学、产业结构理论、银行体系结构理论。
AI.method: 两阶段实证方法：第一阶段估计区域层面的脉冲响应函数并检验异质性；第二阶段使用合成指标（反映地方工业和银行体系关键结构特征）探索异质性的驱动因素。
AI.findings: 1. 货币政策对意大利区域经济存在统计显著的异质性影响；2. 响应方差的大部分可由区域产业结构强度差异解释；3. 企业财务脆弱性和地方信贷体系中小型银行占比也有解释力，但程度较低。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 拓展了货币政策区域传导机制的理论理解；2. 识别了产业结构作为关键调节变量；3. 为区域异质性研究提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供区域差异化的政策考量；2. 帮助识别对货币政策更敏感的区域；3. 为区域经济结构调整提供政策建议。

title: A Note on Trade Under Regime Uncertainty
affiliations: Radford University - Department of Economics and Radford University - Department of Economics

detail.title: A Note on Trade Under Regime Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Trade is generally good for economies. This finding permeates economics, though there are still attempts to undermine it. There are stylized game theoretic models that may indicate strategic benefits to tariffs, but even these models do not necessarily address the secondary effects of erratic tariff policies. When tariff policies are difficult to predict, the policy uncertainty creates its own negative pressure on production. This note speaks to the concept that there are more than two players in a trade war.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文指出，虽然贸易通常对经济有益，但不可预测的关税政策会通过政策不确定性对生产产生负面影响，强调贸易战中存在多方参与者。
AI.research_question: 不可预测的关税政策如何通过政策不确定性影响生产，以及贸易战中多方参与者的动态如何？
AI.motivation: 尽管经济学普遍认为贸易对经济有益，但仍有试图削弱这一观点的尝试。现有博弈论模型可能显示关税的战略利益，但未能充分解决不可预测关税政策的次级效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型、贸易政策不确定性理论、多方参与者贸易战分析框架
AI.method: 概念性分析/理论推演（基于现有博弈论模型和政策不确定性理论）
AI.findings: 不可预测的关税政策会产生政策不确定性，对生产造成负面影响；贸易战涉及多方参与者，而不仅仅是两个国家之间的博弈。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了贸易政策分析框架，强调政策不确定性的重要性；提出了贸易战中多方参与者的概念，超越了传统的双边博弈模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于关税政策可预测性重要性的见解；强调了在贸易政策设计中考虑多方参与者动态的必要性。

detail.abstract: Europe's pursuit of strategic autonomy has intensified in response to geopolitical shocks, energy market disruptions and growing concerns over technological sovereignty. While policy initiatives frequently frame these challenges as sector-specific or temporary, this thesis argues that Europe's vulnerabilities in energy, defence and digital infrastructure constitute a structural configuration of dependency that constrains autonomous decision-making even in the absence of explicit coercion.

AI.tldr: 欧洲追求战略自主性因地缘政治冲击、能源市场动荡和技术主权担忧而加剧。本文认为欧洲在能源、国防和数字基础设施方面的脆弱性构成了结构性依赖配置，即使在没有明显胁迫的情况下也限制了自主决策能力。
AI.research_question: 欧洲在能源、国防和数字基础设施方面的脆弱性如何构成结构性依赖配置，从而限制其战略自主决策能力？

AI.theoretical_framework: 战略自主性理论、依赖理论、结构脆弱性理论、主权与自主决策理论
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明，但可能包括案例研究分析（能源、国防、数字基础设施领域）、政策文件分析、依赖关系评估等定性研究方法

title: Are Sell-Side Analysts Up to the Challenge of Climate Change?
affiliations: University of Melbourne, University of Melbourne - Department of Finance, University of Oklahoma - Michael F. Price College of Business and University of Oklahoma - Michael F. Price College of Business

detail.title: Are Sell-Side Analysts Up to the Challenge of Climate Change?
detail.abstract: Estimating the financial implications of climate change presents a significant challenge, one that aligns with the specialized expertise of sell-side analysts. This study examines analysts' performance in this context and finds that they exhibit systematic pessimism in their earnings forecasts for carbon-intensive firms. Our results suggest this pessimism is more likely represents a mistake rather than deliberate strategic behavior. Analysts appear to conflate elevated discount rates with diminished earnings prospects. Analysts with prior professional experience in pollutionintensive industries exhibit greater pessimism, suggesting this error is more likely driven by limitations in financial expertise rather than a lack of industry-specific knowledge.

AI.tldr: 研究发现卖方分析师在评估碳密集型公司时存在系统性悲观偏见，这种偏见更多是由于财务专业知识不足导致的错误，而非故意策略行为。分析师倾向于将高折现率与低盈利前景混淆，且在污染密集型行业有经验的分析师表现出更大的悲观倾向。
AI.research_question: 分析师在评估气候变化对碳密集型公司财务影响时的表现如何？他们的悲观预测是出于战略考虑还是专业能力不足导致的错误？

AI.theoretical_framework: 分析师行为理论、气候金融、行为金融学、专业能力与偏见理论

2. 这种偏见更可能是错误而非故意策略行为
